machine: AMD Zen 4, 17 threads, fp32, no GPU

runs.cmd: scripts/inference_neodragon.py --prompt 'A red fox running through fresh snow in a pine forest at sunrise' --seed 42 --fast --interpolate 2 --num_frames 97 --disable_safety_checker
runs.observation: 97-frame (4 s) generation works; subject stays coherent, but colours over-saturate and the fox drifts out of frame in the second half (model distilled on 49 frames)

runs.cmd: scripts/inference_neodragon.py --prompt 'Waves crashing on black volcanic rocks, slow motion, golden hour' --image waves.png --seed 7 --fast --disable_safety_checker
runs.observation: image-to-video keeps the input picture as frame 0 and animates the wave

note: Wall time includes ~20-25 s of model loading; per-clip generation times are in results/cpu_benchmark.json
